---
name: Agent task
about: A structured task for coding agents to execute
labels: agent
---

## Task summary
One‑line description.

## Context and goal
Background and the desired outcome.

## Scope
- Files/services involved (frontend, node_api, app, api, tests)
- What is explicitly out of scope

## Deliverables
Code changes, tests, docs updates.

## Constraints
Tooling constraints, performance targets, a11y requirements.

## Suggested approach (optional)
Pointers to patterns, modules, or tests to reference.

## Definition of done
- [ ] Code implemented
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing
- [ ] Lint/type checks pass where configured
- [ ] Docs updated

## Validation steps
Commands to run (e.g., pytest -q; npm test --prefix node_api; npm run dev --prefix frontend).

## Risks
Edge cases and rollout concerns.
